claude_proposed_widenings.name: composite_magic_item_mechanics (held passive + attunement-triggered persistent curse)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines a normal held passive with a curse that begins on attunement and persists on the bearer even after the shield is removed. The current magic-item families do not model that split honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this Shield, you have Resistance to damage from attacks made with Ranged weapons. ... Attuning to it curses you until you are targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic. Removing the Shield fails to end the curse on you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: redirect_target_to_cursed_bearer
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The curse deterministically rewrites attack targeting so the cursed bearer becomes the target of a ranged-weapon attack aimed at a nearby creature. Existing atoms cover mitigation, negation, and roll modification, but not automatic target substitution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: curse_lifecycle (begins on attunement, persists after item removal, ends on remove_curse-like cleanup)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The curse is not a simple while-held or while-attuned passive. It starts on attunement, survives removing the shield, and ends only through curse-removal magic. That lifecycle is not represented by the existing magic-item mechanics families.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Attuning to it curses you until you are targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic. Removing the Shield fails to end the curse on you.
